sanskrit: pārthena nihatān saṃkhye mahā indra upama vikramān an icchataḥ katham vīra droṇasya yudhi pāṇḍavaḥ priyaḥ hi phalgunaḥ nityam ācāryasya mahātmanaḥ
english: How, indeed, could Phalguna, in spite of the resistance offered by Drona in battle, accomplish his vow by slaying the ruler of the Sindhus? If Drona had not himself willed it, O hero, how could the son of Pandu, in battle, have pierced that impenetrable array, overcoming his struggling preceptor? Truly, Phalguna is exceedingly dear to the illustrious preceptor! For this, the latter gave him admittance, without having fought with him.
